title: The Local AI Stack — Data API v1 (submissions)
description: Formal JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the canonical dataset published at /data.json and /data/api/v1/submissions.json: community-sourced local-LLM hardware/model/performance reports, pulled weekly from the Level1Techs matrix thread. The 'version' field identifies the API generation. See /data/api/README.md for the full contract, versioning policy, and changelog.

version.description: Data API version (major.minor). A breaking change to this shape bumps the major version and moves the published files to data/api/vN/; additive changes bump the minor in place.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the pipeline run that produced this dataset (the weekly automated pull).

schema_version.description: Version of tools/schema.json — the curation vocabulary (tiers, vendors, backends, quants, use cases) — that this dataset was parsed against.

source_thread.description: The source forum thread the submissions were pulled from.

total_submissions.description: Number of records in 'submissions'. Must equal len(submissions).

skipped_templates.description: Unfilled template posts seen in the thread and excluded from 'submissions'.

submissions.description: The community submissions — one record per reported setup.

id.description: Stable unique identifier: post_<post-number>_<username>_<n>, where <n> disambiguates multiple submissions in one post.

post_number.description: 1-based post number in the source thread.

username.description: The submitter's forum handle (credited on the site).

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the post was created.

type.description: 'full' = the complete submission template; 'quick' = a minimal report.

raw.description: The original [COMMUNITY-SUBMISSION] block fields, verbatim. The key set varies by submission type (quick reports carry fewer). Preserved for provenance — consumers should use the normalized fields.

description.description: Free-text hardware description (GPUs, VRAM, CPU, RAM).

backend.description: Inference engine as reported. May carry a version or qualifier in parentheses (e.g. 'vLLM (magiccodingman/vllm-radiance, adaptive MTP=8)'); the canonical name is the leading token.

name.description: Model name as reported (repo/model, quant, etc.).

url.description: Where the model file is downloaded from (HuggingFace, …).

use_cases.description: Free-text use cases as reported. The site's client tools normalize these against the schema's use-case categories.

stable.description: Context length tested stable, e.g. '65536 tokens (NIAH hit YES at 65k)'.

decode_tps.description: Decode throughput in tokens/s, e.g. '54.4' or '54.4 decode'.

ttft_cold.description: Time to first token on a cold start, e.g. '19.3s'.

engine_mode.description: Where the model lives in memory. Empty string = not reported (the common case in v1).

notes.description: The submitter's setup notes: launch flags, quirks, what worked, what didn't.

lifecycle.description: Curation lifecycle state of the entry.

highlight.description: Curator flag: feature this entry on the homepage.
